explanation: I used WP_HTML_Processor::create_fragment() to preserve the fragment byte-for-byte while scanning structure, then iterated with next_tag(), checked the current tag name with get_tag(), inspected ancestry with get_breadcrumbs(), and added the class via add_class() only when an ancestor UL or OL was present. The modified markup is read back with get_updated_html(), which preserves untouched bytes exactly.
